The [[Orshad Chieftain]] is the leader of a tribe of savage man-eating centaurs known as the [[Orshad Raiders]].

== Locations ==
* [[Crystal Desert]]
** {{NPC location|The Scar}} (during [[The Warrior's Path]])

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Hunter's Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Read the Wind}}
* {{skill icon|Storm Chaser}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Losaru Bowmaster Vest]]
* [[Losaru Mane]]

== Notes ==
* The Orshad Chieftain's spawn point actually belongs to one of six random [[Centaur]] [[boss]]es.  So while this quest is active, one of the normal six bosses will not spawn.  The bosses that may spawn in the remaining five spawn points are [[Aguo Gruffmane]], [[Caza Windedcalf]], [[Mina Brillianthaunch]], [[Gret Waveringmane]], [[Zalo Soulhaunch]], and [[Doro Icehide]].
